title: Show HN: Lumabri – Run Moe Models on a P2P Swarm with Colibri
summary: Lumabri is a peer-to-peer swarm platform that enables distributed execution of Mixture of Experts (MoE) AI models using the Colibri protocol, allowing users to run large language models collaboratively without centralized infrastructure.
problem_solved: Enables decentralized and privacy-preserving execution of computationally expensive MoE models by distributing inference workload across a volunteer peer-to-peer network.
why_valuable: Reduces the barrier to running large AI models by eliminating the need for expensive centralized cloud infrastructure while providing better privacy through distributed computation.
